text:
emma: Quick sanity check before the KPI email  dashboard shows a sudden uplift in "launch content" leads but demo invites and MRR aren't budging. https://app.redwood.com/dash/weekly
casey: did we change any landing page JS or the confirmation flow?
ryan: Not on the page, but we did roll a shortened URL for the social post yesterday.
analytics-bot: [auto] Spike detected: 940 campaign-attributed regs in last 6h vs baseline 320. High share of empty utm_term and utm_campaign fields.
ops: pulled the redirect logs  shortlink proxy dropped query params on some redirects (provider timeout fallback). 58% of clicks lost campaign tags.
casey: so those should probably be classified as campaign when the referer indicates the post, but our ingest now tags them as 'direct'. inflates campaign math when we backfill by session.
emma: ok do not surface the raw MQL headline in the KPI email. For the weekly readout show: (A) raw MQLs, (B) campaign-attributed (utm present), and (C) adjusted estimate where we reassign probable campaign via referrer heuristics.
ryan: i'll run a quick reassign script and upload the CSV to the dashboard team in ~20m.
ops: filing ticket with shortlink provider and reconfiguring proxy to preserve querystring on fallback. will post ETA.
sales-bot: FYI  12 leads routed to AE queue from that cohort; pausing low-touch auto-schedule until quality confirmed.
emma: action list: (1) ops fix shortlink & note in postmortem (ops) (2) ryan produce adjusted MQL view + CSV (ryan) (3) pause auto-schedule for affected leads (sales-bot) (4) update KPI slide with 3-column view and a footnote (emma/casey). We'll review in the weekly KPI huddle. :calendar:
analytics-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review in 40m  attach adjusted numbers to slides.
casey: I'll draft the bench paragraph calling out tracking vs. genuine lift. Keep the headline conservative.
emma: thanks all  keeping this thread linked to the KPI deck for transparency.
